title: A ten-library single-cell audit of flavored e-cigarette aerosols in mouse lung
question: Which metabolic and signaling responses to terpene exposure are reproducible, and which depend on cellular context or a specific target?

sources.title: NCBI GEO series GSE263903 and sample records
Kaur et al., eLife 2026, single-cell flavored e-cigarette aerosol study

claims.text: GSE263903 contains mouse-lung single-cell libraries for air, PG:VG, Mango, MentholMint, and Tobacco aerosol conditions. This audit includes all ten libraries, one male and one female pool per condition. The paper states that each library pools two mice of one sex and that the flavored e-liquids contain tobacco-derived nicotine.
claims.limitation: The GEO library is the measurable unit here; individual mouse variation cannot be recovered from pooled cells. MentholMint is a mixture, not an isolated menthol exposure.

claims.text: The ten filtered 10x matrices contain 76,229 barcodes; 74,117 pass this notebook's minimum 500 UMI, 200 detected genes, and at most 20% mitochondrial UMI thresholds. The male PG:VG library retains 2,451 cells, the fewest of the ten libraries.
claims.limitation: These are QC counts from already filtered 10x matrices using this notebook's thresholds; they do not reproduce the paper's cell filtering or cell-type annotations. Capture differences can distort apparent composition.

claims.text: The exploratory myeloid-marker bin comprises 15.8% of retained male PG:VG cells and 21.9% of retained male menthol-mint cells; the corresponding female fractions are 14.7% and 18.0%.
claims.limitation: The bins use five marker genes and are not validated cell types. Sex pools, collection date, capture, and cell-state mixtures remain confounded.

claims.text: Within the myeloid-marker bin, menthol-mint versus PG:VG log2 CPM differences for Il1b are +1.65 in the male library and +1.46 in the female library; for Cxcl2 they are +1.43 and +1.19, respectively.
claims.limitation: These are pooled-library descriptions, not differential-expression estimates or independent biological replications. Changes in the marker-bin mixture can affect pseudobulk abundance.

claims.text: The control choice changes the descriptive contrast: against air, female myeloid-bin Il1b and Cxcl2 differences are only +0.19 and +0.21 log2 CPM, compared with +1.46 and +1.19 against PG:VG.
claims.limitation: Air and PG:VG have distinct exposure and collection dates. A smaller contrast to air does not identify which aerosol component caused a response.

claims.text: In the same targeted myeloid-bin panel, Hmgcr differs by +0.07 log2 CPM in the male library and -0.13 in the female library for menthol-mint versus PG:VG; this audit does not identify a consistent Hmgcr direction across the two sex pools.
claims.limitation: One targeted gene is not a pathway analysis. The design cannot distinguish exposure effects from sex and date effects.

claims.text: The paper reports flavor-dependent aerosol metal levels and a nicotine-only control for selected follow-up assays, but GEO's ten single-cell libraries do not contain a nicotine-only scRNA-seq arm. GEO records the PG:VG, air, Mango, MentholMint, and Tobacco collection dates as October 20, October 21, November 4, November 11, and November 18, 2022, respectively.
claims.limitation: Treatment and collection date are confounded in these archived libraries; the study cannot isolate a menthol-specific transcriptional effect.

claims.text: Adding the other flavor arms changes the descriptive context. Within the myeloid-marker bin, MentholMint versus Mango Il1b differences are +0.30 male and +0.22 female log2 CPM, and Cxcl2 differences are +0.15 and +0.38. Versus Tobacco, the same genes have opposite signs between the two sex pools for Il1b (+0.34 male, -0.54 female) and Cxcl2 (+0.75 male, -0.88 female).
claims.limitation: Each flavor arm is a complex nicotine-containing formulation collected on a different date. These library-level descriptions cannot identify a flavor-specific molecule or infer sex interactions.

claims.text: A discriminating follow-up would randomize independent mice across collection days and compare vehicle, nicotine-only, purified menthol, menthol plus nicotine, and matched aerosol controls within each sex. Analyze validated cell types using mouse-level pseudobulk and include measured aerosol chemistry and exposure dose.
claims.limitation: This experiment is proposed only; no such data were generated or analyzed here.
